notes.en:
- [[set:eagle]] is not a default replacement for [[set:poet]]. This build is an Ultimate-spam/Action Advance support build, built around Tribbie's low Ultimate cost. Ideally she would want [[set:eagle]], [[set:vonwacq]], and [[light-cone:ddd]]. The goal is to cycle her Ultimate as often as possible so the teama gets repeated Action Advance, rather than maximizing Tribbie's personal damage.
- Use this over [[set:poet]] when your team benefits more from turn manipulation than from Tribbie's damage output, such as in sustainless teams, particularly in 0-cycle/low-cycle endgame content. For general use-case, [[set:poet]] should still be Best in Slot.

summary.en:
- Tribbie is a Harmony support capable of unleashing frequent Follow-Up ATKs and Ultimates.
- At the start of combat or after Tribbie uses her Ultimate, the next time each ally uses their Ultimate, Tribbie will use an AoE Follow-Up ATK.
- Tribbie is a core support for The Herta, contributing frequent AoE Follow-up ATKs helping stack "Interpretation" while also dealing solid sub-DPS.
- Outside of The Herta teams, Tribbie often falls behind more specialized support units, though her general buffs still make her a strong secondary option.

details.en:
- E1 causes the enemy with the highest HP to take True DMG equal to 24% of the non-True DMG dealt to enemies after an ally attacks. This Eidolon is a strong overall damage boost and is especially powerful with AoE damage dealers by concentrating damage onto higher priority targets.
- S1 provides a large personal damage boost, grants Energy at the start of combat and after her Follow-Up ATKs, and gives the team a CRIT DMG% buff.
